item.title: Let's Learn Go -- (5) Goroutine and Channel
item.description: 1. The Concurrency Model in Go 1.1 The Communication Model: CSP CSP stands for Communicating Sequential Process, a model for concurrent communication. A Process can use many Channels, and a Channel does not care who is using it — it is only responsible for sending and receiving data. In the Go community there is a very famous maxim: do not communicate by sharing memory; instead, share memory by communicating.
